people.name: Ophir
people.line: A region known for its gold

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
translations.bsb: They sailed to Ophir and imported gold from there—420 talents —and delivered it to Solomon.
translations.kjv: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
